description: Screenshot of the Wired article 'Pentagon Kills LifeLog Project' (Feb 4 2004) — DARPA's cancelled program to build a database tracking a person's entire existence. Paired in Q lore with Facebook's founding the same day.
text: WIRED STAFF. BUSINESS. 02.04.04 12:00 PM. PENTAGON KILLS LIFELOG PROJECT. THE PENTAGON CANCELED its so-called LifeLog project, an ambitious effort to build a database tracking a person's entire existence. Run by Darpa, the Defense Department's research arm, LifeLog aimed to gather in a single place just about everything an individual says, sees or does: the phone calls made, the TV shows watched, the magazines read, the plane tickets bought, the e-mail sent and received. Out of this seemingly endless ocean of information, computer scientists would plot distinctive routes in the data, mapping relationships, memories, events and experiences.
